memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-04-07 09:00 with Dr Karthik Hegde (D04) for initial consultation.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic kidney disease
  - Status: Stable, eGFR 48 mL/min/1.73m2, serum creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, urine ACR 45 mg/g.
  - Plan: Continue telmisartan 40 mg 1-0-0 after food, dapagliflozin 10 mg 1-0-0 after food, furosemide 20 mg 1-0-0 after food, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg 0-1-0 after food.
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
  - Status: HbA1c 7.8%, fasting glucose 152 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Start metformin 500 mg 1-0-1 after food, glimepiride 1 mg 1-0-0 before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg 1-0-0 after food, empagliflozin 10 mg 1-0-0 after food.
- Vitamin D deficiency
  - Status: Serum 25-OH vitamin D 18 ng/mL (insufficient).
  - Plan: Cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then 1000 IU 1-0-0 after food.
- Weight: 68 kg, waist circumference 82 cm (above female cut-off of 80 cm).
  - Plan: Diet advice: Breakfast – reduce refined carbs, include protein; Lunch – portion-controlled rice with vegetables; Dinner – light soup and salad. Encourage walking 30 mins daily.
Due: HbA1c repeat on 2025-07-07.

memories.text: I have been feeling more tired than usual over the past week, especially after my morning walk. My feet sometimes feel swollen by evening. I am taking all my medicines as prescribed.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Chronic kidney disease
  - Status: eGFR 46 mL/min/1.73m2, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, urine ACR 48 mg/g; mild increase.
  - Plan: Continue current CKD meds; add furosemide 20 mg 1-0-0 after food if edema worsens.
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
  - Status: HbA1c 7.2%, fasting glucose 138 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Continue metformin, glimepiride, sitagliptin, empagliflozin; consider reducing glimepiride if hypoglycemia.
- Vitamin D deficiency
  - Status: 25-OH vitamin D 22 ng/mL after 4 weeks loading.
  - Plan: Continue cholecalciferol 60000 IU weekly for remaining 4 weeks, then switch to 1000 IU OD.
- Weight: 67.5 kg, waist circumference 81 cm (above 80 cm cut‑off).
  - Plan: Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with egg; Lunch – mixed vegetable curry with small rice portion; Dinner – dal and steamed vegetables. Walk 30 mins daily, monitor edema.
Due: HbA1c repeat on 2025-10-03.
